en.title: Israeli Strikes and Gunfire Kill Four People in Gaza
en.dek: Recent Israeli military action in the Gaza Strip leaves four people dead, according to medics and news reports.
facts: Four people were killed by Israeli strikes and gunfire in Gaza.
Medics stated that a father and a son were among those killed by the fire.
A third person was killed by gunfire in Khan Younis.
Reports confirmed the casualties resulting from the military operations.
body: Israeli strikes and gunfire resulted in four deaths in the Gaza Strip, according to reports published on 10 November 2026. The operations caused casualties across multiple locations in the territory as military action continued.
Medics stated that the fire killed a father and a son during the incidents. Details regarding the exact circumstances of their deaths were provided by medical personnel responding to the scene.
A third person was killed by gunfire in Khan Younis, according to statements from medics. Khan Younis has been a frequent site of military activity during the ongoing conflict.
The identity of the fourth victim and the precise location of the fourth fatality were included in the overall death toll reported by news outlets.
Medical teams in the Gaza Strip continue to respond to sites affected by Israeli strikes and ground operations. These responders report on casualties as they reach areas impacted by the fire.

The Boston Globe, Arab News, and The Straits Times published accounts of the strikes and gunfire based on information from medics on the ground. Further details regarding the total extent of the damage are expected as reports are verified.
en.context: The Gaza Strip has experienced continuous military conflict involving Israeli forces and local factions. Medical infrastructure in the territory operates under severe strain while responding to casualties from ongoing strikes.
